svg.text: NESTING ON 1200 x 800 BLANKS (MaxRects, 6 mm gap, 8 mm margin) - cad/dxf/nest/
Blanks are the 1200 x 800 sheet / bed size. Each nest
DXF has the parts on CUT and the blank on SHEET.
11 steel 1.2 blanks: the big skins cannot share a
blank (no two fit together), so their offcuts
carry the strips, stiffeners, keepers and skirts.
PD1 (8 mm), PC1 (3 mm) and RR1 (2 mm) are small:
cut them from offcuts or order them as cut parts;
their nests are shown for completeness.
Parts may turn 90 deg (no grain on coated steel).
6 mm between parts, 8 mm from the blank edge.
SRA-16 Silent AC Rack - laser-cut sheet-metal parts
FOR CUTTING - DXF is the master; confirm hardware (sheet 5)
